spanish: Habla a Aarón y a sus hijos, diciendo: Esta *es* la ley del pecado; en lugar que se degollará el holocausto se degollará el pecado delante de Jehová; santidad de santidades ella.
grammarChanges: Translated the untranslated loanword 'torá' to 'ley' (common noun תּוֹרַת, H8451, construct; not a proper name).
Supplied the copula *es* in italics to complete the verbless nominal clause 'Esta [es] la ley del pecado'.
Changed the first niphal imperfect 3fs verb from present 'se degüella' to future 'se degollará' to match the tense of the second occurrence of the same verb form (תִּשָּׁחֵט).
readerNote: Supplied the copula *es* to complete the verbless nominal clause and set both niphal imperfect 3fs verbs to future (se degollará) for tense consistency.
